layers.observation: Measurement of software systems and repositories

modules.name: vaHera
modules.summary: The Buhera OS language: categorical memory, backward navigation to the penultimate state, triple-equivalence verification — executed on a module-owned kernel.
modules.residue: Rendered results produced by the act (a count; vaHera has no distance-to-solution).

modules.name: ndombolo (Turbulance runtime)
modules.summary: kwasa-kwasa's deterministic Turbulance runtime: cell-wise evaluation with store deltas, a rule trace, proposition scores and the static contact graph.
modules.residue: Trace events deposited by the act (a count; ndombolo's theory forbids a verdict).

modules.name: Systems Biology Shaders
modules.summary: Compile and run .sbs circuits: S-entropy observation on WebGL2 (CPU fallback), coherence R, flux visibility V, backward navigation, l1 therapy.
modules.residue: 1 − V: distance of the observed flux pattern from the healthy baseline (0 when unperturbed or nothing observed).
side_effects: WebGL2 context per run (browser; CPU fallback)

modules.name: SBS observation calculus (Rust)
modules.summary: The hegel Rust port of the SBS calculus, without the DSL: S-entropy, R and V for an explicit circuit, an SBML model or the glycolysis demo, under explicit edge perturbations.

modules.name: Tempus timing language
modules.summary: stella-lorraine's timing language — cells over the timing residual ΔP, sync channels, composition, when→action rules — statically checked, with a seeded synthetic-event simulator.
modules.residue: compile/construct/compose: error diagnostics; simulate: fraction of requested synthetic events not yet generated.

modules.name: HFQ federated query
modules.summary: The hegel federated query interpreter: capability-checked plans over fixture worlds with water-filling budget allocation and a six-verdict result.
modules.residue: Steps whose verdict is neither answer nor empty (blocked steps).

modules.name: pylon (SRN, yield market, process agents)
modules.summary: Sango Rine Shumba glyphs, a separation-cost yield market and persistent goal-directed process agents on a module-owned cluster.
modules.residue: The agent's goal distance (geometric, in goal space; not progress on the glyph body, which pylon never executes).

modules.name: Wind Tunnel (.wt)
modules.summary: Parse .wt analysis scripts and adjudicate their assertions against a measured metric view; measure a project with the local wt binary when configured.
modules.residue: (failed + skipped) / assertions; 1 on a parse error.
side_effects: measure only: spawns $BUHERA_WT_BIN (Rust host), writes a temp .wt file and <project>/.wt/

modules.name: Repo character χ
modules.summary: bloodhound's repo-federation tracker, read-only half: χ, the Stoer–Wagner minimum cut of a repo's purpose self-graph, with load-bearing blocks and fragment count.
modules.residue: 0 (χ is a conserved invariant, not a distance).
side_effects: character_at / list (Rust host only): read <repo>/.purpose/index.json and <root>/.tracker/federation.json

modules.name: Zangalewa
modules.summary: The OS's only AI module: natural-language instructions → DSL chunks the owning compiler accepts (generate → validate → repair); every accepted draft returned.
modules.residue: Fraction of drafts the owning compiler rejected (syntactic only; no semantic claim).
side_effects: TS: HTTP to the interceptor broker (default 127.0.0.1:4319)
